policy.thresholds: Numerical tolerances are arithmetic/physics invariants. All biological numeric thresholds are engineering acceptance targets, NOT established healthy norms. Tighten using measurement repeatability where available; never loosen after confirmation.
policy.uncertainty: When independent measurement standard uncertainty u exists, also require standardized_RMSE<=2 and >=95% within2u. Population SD is not u.
policy.splits: Calibration: fit; screening: choose model; confirmation: untouched subjects/conditions, never used for refit. Ablation: disable one feature at a time. Numerical/source equations are not independent biological observations.
policy.normalization: Fixed calibration reference scale per joint/direction. A zero/unknown scale is not evaluable. Never normalize by candidate output.
policy.aggregation: Report every joint/direction/condition and subject; equal-weight subject macro scores; no pooled averaging to hide failures. Candidate adoption requires all required primary and safety gates, no missing evidence.
policy.repeated_confirmation: A failed confirmation remains a failed candidate result. Subsequent fit makes that set screening; new untouched data is required for independent final confirmation.

policy.source_scope: Anderson Table3 curve reproduction and first-order activation analytic tests validate software only. GAS source sign remains unresolved. No clinical validity claimed.

scope_policy.reason: User clarified joint-level plant implementation; controller training is outside scope. Supplementary measurements are retained separately, not required to establish joint-model numerical correctness.
scope_policy.threshold_interpretation: Engineering targets are provisional acceptance proposals, not established biological norms or measurement-derived tolerances.

accounting.scope: Substep torque/work/limit metrics and numerical assays; backend validation coverage remains assay-specific.

strength.scope: 69 directional constant caps; sagittal hip/knee/ankle angle-speed candidates; source cohort/size and explicit capacity scaling. No full-body measured force envelope.

activation.scope: Directional first-order joint activation proxy, reset/replay support. Independent joint torque onset/release measurements missing.

passive_rom.scope: 69 independent bounds, lower-limb coupled exponential energy and wrist linear springs. Multi-axis posture-dependent anatomical bounds missing; fitted passive candidate not adopted.

impedance.scope: Passive tangent K/B and perturbation fitting metrics. Explicit joint API coactivation allocates balanced opposing effort within directional activation caps. No measured activation-dependent stiffness/damping law; simulator default net-torque interface unchanged.

multiaxis.scope: Independent axis bounds only; no coupled multi-axis active torque envelope.

viscoelastic.scope: Memoryless springs and viscous damping can dissipate cycle work; no tissue relaxation or internal history state.

fatigue.scope: Candidate three-compartment ODE integrated into explicitly mapped joint torque directions, available-capacity diagnostics, reset and replay; numerical and short MuJoCo checks only. No independent endurance/recovery validation; independent directional reservoirs remain an assumption. Source endurance-error reproduction remains unresolved: tested dt and two unfatigued initial conditions do not explain the high-load reference-curve discrepancy.

series_elastic.scope: No separate series elastic displacement or force transmission state.

foot_kinematics.scope: Existing rigid-body engine and contact geometry; no identified compliant foot/pressure model.

personalization.scope: Strength reference cohort/size and per-direction scale only; body geometry/inertia and subject-level validation missing.

output_variability.scope: No physiological motor output noise; policy exploration/action noise is not equivalent.

walking.scope: Historical frozen-controller diagnostics; controller training outside current user scope.

implementation_coverage_policy: Source-code coverage inventory, not experimental pass/fail or biological validation. Conditional roadmap items remain recorded and unimplemented, not marked complete.

NGUYEN2020_reliability.applies_to: EOD fitted EL/VI summaries under source reliability protocol only
NGUYEN2020_reliability.unit_caution: VI retains source Hz regression definition; do not directly use as physical B uncertainty
NGUYEN2020_reliability.percentage_caution: Source SEM% is not SEM divided by reported mean; do not use as a global percentage tolerance
NGUYEN2020_reliability.gate_usage: Context only until population/protocol/observable compatibility established; MDC is paired-change detectability, not model accuracy

delivery_scope.priority: Finish L0 and L1 verification/fixes before adopting L2 candidates
L1: basic passive elasticity and damping with explicit coverage
delivery_scope.interpretation: Levels classify delivery scope, not implementation version or biological validation. Preserve deferred code/evidence; do not count it toward L0-L2 completion.
